# Half-press (S1) event hook site, OM-5 1.2

The E-P7 SD-loader trigger call, byte-identical apart from its displacement; a 5-byte call in section 1.

**Category:** hook site · **Address:** `0x602ed768` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om5 firmware 1.2, build 1200](../firmware/om5-1200.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-5](../cameras/om5.md)

Counterpart of E-P7 0x602c805f. The port replaces it with a jump to a trampoline that replays the call and returns to 0x602ed76d with registers and stack as stock.

## Observations

- **Emulator** ([Caduceus port for the original OM-5 (tadejs)](../projects/caduceus-om5-tadejs.md)): om-emu E144 counts S1 presses through the hook; stock leaves the counter at zero. Source: [Original OM-5 port notes (tadejs)](../sources/tom5.port.md).
- **Physical camera** ([Caduceus port for the original OM-5 (tadejs)](../projects/caduceus-om5-tadejs.md)): Ladder C4 and C5 hooked here; half-press, focus, photos, playback and menus normal. Source: [Original OM-5 port notes (tadejs)](../sources/tom5.port.md).
